audit_items.proof_trace: `_verifyCanSupplyTokens` enforces `amount == totalTokensAllocated` and `safeTransferFrom` deposits exactly that amount into the contract (fees are transferred directly from msg.sender to receivers, not from the contract balance), so the invariant holds at supply time. Per-investor `hasSettled` flags prevent double-claiming, and the only code path that can drain `askToken` post-supply is `emergencyWithdraw` (L474-481), which is an explicitly labeled admin escape hatch callable only by Legion and is intentional by design.
